intro: On 27 November 1971, a few hours before Mars 2 entered orbit, its descent capsule separated and headed for the surface. The descent system failed — probably because the capsule came in too steeply — the parachute did not open, and it struck the ground: the first human-made object to reach the surface of Mars. Inside was PrOP-M, a small rover built to walk on skis at the end of a tether. The orbiter worked on into 1972.

chapters.title: Arrival
chapters.subtitle: 27 November 1971 — the first object on Mars

images.caption: The 1972 Soviet stamp for the Mars 2 automatic station: the pennant it carried reached the planet on 27 November 1971.
Mars 2's descent capsule was the same design as Mars 3's, shown on this 1972 stamp. Mars 3 landed softly five days later and sent a signal for about 20 seconds.
